behavior: In a single real workspace, after java_code_actions mints an actionId handle for a code action on one file, editing a different file elsewhere in the same workspace (never the action's own file) before resolving still invalidates the handle: java_apply_code_action's resolve call errors rather than returning the action's edit.
rationale: INV-CA-1 binds resolvability to 'the same workspace sync generation' (feat-tool-code-actions: one workspace-wide counter, not per-file), so its literal 'any file in the workspace changed' is broader than TCON-CA-0001's same-file case [INV-CA-1]. Falsifies checking only the action's own file's mtime/generation, not the workspace's whole generation -- indistinguishable from correct by TCON-CA-0001 alone.
